author: smorgasburg
title: Looking for local illustrator for 2027 NYC vendor application flyer
content: Smorgasburg, through your eyes. 🎨 Calling all local artists! We’re looking for a local illustrator or designer to create our 2027 NYC vendor application flyer! This is a paid commission, with full artist credit and the potential for many future collaborations. We want to see something different from our past flyers. Something unmistakably New York that captures the messy, human experience of eating here: hands making food, friends sharing a bite, cultures meeting across a counter. Your style, your perspective. Submit your portfolio or Instagram through the link in bio by November 10. A sketch is optional, but including one helps us understand your vision and may speed up our review—rough ideas are welcome. The final flyer, featuring the selected artist’s work, will be posted on November 20. Know someone we should see? Tag them below. Contact: link in bio.

author: mostafa_gawad
title: Hiring Vector Background Artists for JUMP ANIMATION series
content: 🎨 WE’RE HIRING! – VECTOR BACKGROUND ARTISTS JUMP ANIMATION is looking for talented Vector Background Artists to join our upcoming animated series project! Requirements: * Strong skills in creating 2D vector backgrounds. * Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator or Adobe Animate. * Ability to match an established cartoon art style. * Attention to detail and good artistic skills. Project Duration: 2–3 Months (Freelance). Send your CV and Portfolio to: jobs@jumpanimation.com or gawad26@gmail.com. You can also message us directly through Facebook!

author: szewomenofhope
title: Looking for Illustrator for community education projects
content: 🎨 We're looking for an Illustrator! Sze Women of Hope is looking for a creative illustrator to collaborate with us on upcoming education and community projects supporting refugee communities. Location: Remote. Work arrangement: Project-based | Flexible. Interested? We'd love to see your work! Send your portfolio to szewomen@gmail.com.

author: egofilm_studio
title: Hiring Lead Illustrator and Background Illustrator
content: EGoFILM poszukuje Lead Ilustratora oraz Background Ilustratora! Do nowego projektu serialu animowanego szukamy osoby, która będzie odpowiedzialna między innymi za: projektowanie i rozwijanie lokacji oraz backgroundów (background ilustrator), współtworzenie warstwy wizualnej serialu (lead ilustrator), dbanie o spójność stylistyczną ilustracji (lead ilustrator), współpracę z Art Directorem, reżyserami oraz zespołem ilustratorów (lead ilustrator). Jeśli masz doświadczenie w pracy przy projektach animowanych, prześlij swoje portfolio na: rekrutacja@egofilm.pl. Contact: rekrutacja@egofilm.pl
